Troubleshooting Wine tries to address the common issues people are having with running World of Warcraft using Wine on Linux. Important note: Make ABSOLUTELY SURE you run the latest Wine version, as well as the latest version of your graphic card drivers. If you don't, and encounter errors that have been fixed in newer versions... you're out of luck.

Wisps are ancient spirits of nature that inhabit the forestlands of Kalimdor. They are actually the disembodied spirits of deceased night elves who have become one with the forest, though their minds and the way they perceive things is very different than in life.

Wipe is short for wipeout, meaning a situation where the entire party or raid is killed. Sometimes referred to in other games as a "TPK" (Total Party Kill) or "TPW" (Total Party Wipe). Wipes can occur for many reasons — a bad pull, a group member failing to do their job, unexpected adds (e.g., from a patrol or a runner), etc. The term is rarely, if ever, used in PvP. Wiping is actually a central element of the endgame PvE content. As described in Raiding for newbies, the boss mobs in the raid instances are very hard, and only very rarely will one of them be defeated on the very first pull. Normally, bosses have to be "learned" by the raid, which involves many wipes. Some bosses remain

The Wintersaber Trainers is an Alliance-only faction consisting of only two night elven NPCs that can both be found in Winterspring. Quests are available from Rivern Frostwind who is located at the top of Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.

Wipe recovery is recovering from a wipe without having to have characters run back to their corpses from the graveyard. Wipe recovery is especially important in instances where the corpse run is long and where new patrols may have spawned between the instance portal (where resurrection happens) and the place inside the instance where the wipe took place. (Some of the situations discussed below are technically not wipe prevention since not every character died – i.e. it was not a total wipe. However, they will save a run back from the graveyard.) Wise-ear was Drek'Thar's wolf companion. Because Drek'Thar was blind, Wise-ear was his eyes. Drek'Thar sent Wise-ear to find and bring nomadic Orgrim to the Frostwolves, in which the wolf succeeded. During the liberation of the fifth internment camp (which later became the Horde outpost named Hammerfall), Wise-ear was killed. He was then burned on the funeral pyre of Orgrim Doomhammer (who had also been killed in that battle). Many years later, now senile Drek'Thar mentions him while speaking with Muln Earthfury about a shadow and darkness.

The Winterhoof Water Well is located at the edge of the Rolling Plains in southern Mulgore. It has been used as a source for mystical well-stones, used in vision quests, for aeons. It was taken over by the Venture Company in order to control the water supply but were run off by the tauren. Recently the Grimtotem tribe have been tainting the water supply as payback for being exiled from Thunder Bluff.

Winterfall Village is a large village of corrupted furbolgs in the far eastern area of Winterspring, near Everlook. The village was ruled by High Chief Winterfall, who resided in a small cave at the very top of the settlement. It appears that High Chief Winterfall's position has been taken by Grolnar the Berserk, who now resides in the former chieftain's cave.
Witch Doctor Zum'rah is an elite sand troll found in Zul'Farrak. Zum'rah is at first, but when you move near to him he will turn .

The Winterhoof Cleansing Totem is provided as an objective for Winterhoof Cleansing and Winterhoof Cleansing (Classic).

Witch doctors (or witchdoctors and witch-doctors) are spellcasters and alchemists. Witch doctors often use the smoke of an herb known as Witchbane to draw evil from its hiding places. Troll witch doctors utilize voodoo, juju and the arcane. Some witch doctors carve their names into ancestral staves.
The Winterax tribe are a tribe (or clan) of ice trolls led by Korrak the Bloodrager. They are cannibals. The Winterax do not share the unusually large size of their Drakkari brethren.

__NOTOC__ Winterfall Ursas are furbolgs of the Winterfall found in Winterfall Village, to the east of Everlook in Winterspring. The Ursa tend to be near the back of the village. Killing one awards +5 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.

Winterfall Runners are furbolgs found in Felwood and Winterspring. Killing a Winterfall Runner grants +20 reputation with Timbermaw Hold (+22 for a Human with the Diplomacy racial). The three that wander Winterspring, while hostile, are actually neutral and will not attack unless provoked.
Winterfall Shaman are furbolgs found in Winterfall Village in Winterspring. Killing Winterfall Shaman will result in +10 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.
Winterspring Screechers are level 52-53 owls found in Winterspring.

Witch Doctor Mau'ari is a jungle troll quest giver located in Snowden Chalet in Winterspring. She once gave quests that involved gathering E'ko of all kinds of different types for her, which she then trades for buff items. Now just killing the creatures in Winterspring will give the buffs. She was previously located in Everlook and before that in Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ Witchfury is a world drop from level 40 - 48 mobs.
Winter Wolves are wolf mobs that can be found on the eastern side of Chill Breeze Valley in Dun Morogh.

The Winterhoof tribe represents some of the greatest herbalists and alchemists the tauren have to offer. The known members of this clan tend to live within the tauren capital of Thunder Bluff, with Brumn Winterhoof being the notable exception. * Winterhoof Cleansing

__NOTOC__ Winterfall Totemics are furbolgs found in Timbermaw Post in Winterspring. Killing one results in +20 reputation with Timbermaw Hold.

__NOTOC__ Witch Doctor Tor'gash is a jungle troll found at Zabra'jin in Zangarmarsh. He is apparently very stubborn, and believes that by reading the entrails of birds, or by rolling the knucklebones of his ancestors, he can see the future. Since moving to Zangarmarsh, he has taken to using the local Burstcap Mushrooms to read omens.
__NOTOC__ Witch Doctor Mai'jin is a forest troll found in the Hinterlands. He was a leader of the Witherbark tribe.

The Winterfall Crate drops from Winterfall Runners in Winterspring and Felwood.
Winterax Berserkers were dire ice trolls belonging to the Winterax tribe located at the Snowfall Graveyard of Alterac Valley.

Witchbane is said to have been used by hedge mages and witch doctors to draw out evil. It currently is only known to grow in Dustwallow Marsh around the waters of Witch Hill, and very rarely on dry land.
The Witchbane Torch is provided as an objective for Cleansing Witch Hill.

Winterfin Retreat is a small encampment where the surviving Winterfin murlocs from Winterfin Village retreated to after being run out by their brothers, who were under Claximus' influence. The retreat can be found just southwest of Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.
Wintergarde Gryphons are gryphons found at Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.
Wintergarde Gryphon Riders are dwarves located in Dragonblight and Grizzly Hills.
Wintergarde Blacksmiths are humans located at Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.

Wintergarde Keep is the main Alliance base in Dragonblight, built on high ground, and serving as the headquarters for the 7th Legion. The fortress is under siege by the Scourge forces that had taken the surrounding village, while Naxxramas defiantly hovers in the skies outside of the keep. The keep is well-protected behind strong walls and cannon towers. It is made up of barracks and an arcane sanctum.

The Wintergarde Mausoleum is located east of Wintergarde Keep in Dragonblight. There is a second entrance, located right next to the walls of the Keep. The two sections are connected by a tunnel so secret it is not even on the minimap. According to Scourged Mayor Godfrey Goodard, the mausoleum was built by humans beneath the earth of Wintergarde Village. The current defenders of Wintergarde had no knowledge of this mausoleum "under the old village", which was the target of Naxxramas' necromancers. The Alliance soldiers here are under the command of Ambo Cash.

Wintergarde Crypt is a large crypt located next to Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight. Held within the cold stone walls of this crypt are the remains of the nobles and dignitaries that died in Northrend. The Scourge have broken in and now raise the corpses to help with the assault on Wintergarde Keep. Necrolord Amarion can be found at the bottom.
Winterfall's Frozen Necklace is a world drop from level 67 - 72 Northrend mobs.

The Winterskorn clan (or tribe) is a clan of vrykul that live in Skorn and Baleheim in Howling Fjord of Northrend. They are led by Bjorn Halgurdsson. The elders of Winterhoof tribe say that these vrykul may be able to rise from the dead; not unlike the Scourge, but a different kind of undeath.
Winterskorn Scout are vrykul located in the Howling Fjord. They protect the Dragonskin Scroll needed for Sniff Out the Enemy.
Completing this quest unlocks the majority of the quests for this hub, including Kick, What Kick?, Dreadsaber Mastery: Becoming a Predator, and Rhino Mastery: The Test.
The Witch Doctor's Chest can be found in Zul'Farrak, next to Witch Doctor Zum'rah.

Winterhoof Emblem is a special quest item received from Skorn Must Fall!. It is used to summon a Winterhoof Brave to aid you and your group in three missions he gives out. You return the emblem during The Conqueror of Skorn! quest. Upon returning the emblem to Chieftain Ashtotem you are given the second quest in the chain. Keeping the emblem for a little bit while longer might be a good idea as he will help you fight any Vykrul you encounter, making it easier for your character to level up.

Winterhoof Brave is a special form of the Camp Winterhoof Brave, the guards of Camp Winterhoof, he is summoned to aid you after doing the quest Skorn Must Fall! and receiving the Winterhoof Emblem. He will aid you in three missions, Gruesome, But Necessary, Towers of Certain Doom, and Burn Skorn, Burn!. After all three missions are complete you are to return the emblem to Chieftain Ashtotem, although as long as you carry the emblem you can re-summon the brave to aid you in fighting while in Skorn. After you return the emblem you start the The Conqueror of Skorn! questline. It might be a good idea to keep the emblem a little bit longer before returning it as the brave will help you fight any

Wintergrasp Marks of Honor were awarded for participating in the battle for Lake Wintergrasp. Once one side had won, each eligible member of the winning faction received 3 marks, and each eligible member of the losing faction received one. To be eligible, a character must have achieved at least rank of First Lieutenant, and be level 75 or higher.
This item can be purchased for 30 Stone Keeper's Shard or 9 from Knight Dameron or Stone Guard Mukar in Wintergrasp.
Winterfin Clams are used by the Winterfin murlocs as currency.
The Wispcloak is crafted with Tailoring (415); taught by Tailoring trainers, after earning Northrend Dungeonmaster.

There are two sets of weekly quests in Wintergrasp. They are obtained from quest NPCs in Wintergrasp Keep for the defending faction; the attacking faction's quest NPCs are at the site of the incoming portal from Dalaran. When a battle for control of Wintergrasp Keep begins, the quest NPCs despawn. The quests can be completed over multiple battles for control of Wintergrasp Keep. They can be completed while part of a raid group. As of patch 3.1.2 All Lake Wintergrasp daily quests have been changed to a weekly format.
Permanently enchant a cloak to reduce threat slightly and increase Versatility by 5.
The Wintergrasp River, based from Wintergrasp, runs from southeast Sholazar Basin on the south end of The Skyreach Pillar, and leads to the southern part of River's Heart.

Wintergrasp Fortress is the primary objective for control of the Wintergrasp region. The fortress has two layers of walls — the outer wall with the fortress gates, and the inner wall protecting the keep. The fortress also has a siege workshop for the construction of siege weapons for the defense of the fortress, quest-givers, the Wintergrasp quartermaster, and the entrance to the Vault of Archavon. The walls have anti-vehicle turret alcoves all around it, and there are anti-tank rocket launchers available near the fortress' siege workshop.
Wirebrain is primarily a [http://a.wirebrain.de/wow/ mirror hosting] website that also includes patches for World of Warcraft in a plethora of languages.

The Winterfin Caverns is a cave found just behind Winterfin Village in the Borean Tundra. This cave was exposed when an earthquake in Coldarra caused a landslide. A strange makrura (Claximus) came from within and stole away with the Winterfins' tadpoles. When the murlocs went into the caverns to rescue them, they re-emerged, glowing and under the makrura's influence.

Winterfin Village is a small murloc village found on the shores north of Coldarra in the Borean Tundra. The Winterfin tribe lived here in peace, until the recent earthquake caused the nearby caverns to be exposed letting loose a deranged makrura who stole their children. After losing many of their own to his influence they retreated and regrouped at what is now called Winterfin Retreat.
The Wintergarde Mine Bomb can be found within the Wintergarde Mine in the Dragonblight.
Wintergarde Munitions can be found in Wintergarde Munitions Crates scattered around the Carrion Fields near Wintergarde Keep in the Dragonblight.

__NOTOC__ The Wintergrasp Demolisher is the medium form of siege tank in Wintergrasp. It moves at normal foot-speed and is equipped with a battering ram and a catapult. Ideally used for attacking buildings rather than players.

__NOTOC__ The Wintergrasp Siege Engine is a siege vehicle. It is the heaviest form of siege weapon in Wintergrasp. It is quite slow moving and very slow turning and players running on foot can get in front of it pretty easily. Though what it lacks in speed and damage it makes up for in hitpoints, having a massive 85k of them.

Wintergrasp Keep Door is a large door and last defense to the Titan Relic in the Wintergrasp Fortress in Wintergrasp. It is the last line of defense for the Titan Relic, and it's destruction will then reveal the objective, the Titan Relic. Usually, if the door falls, the attacking team will win unless the game is counting down to the last second, or the defense makes an astonishing recovery.
Wintergrasp Fortress Gate is a large gate that protects the entrance to the Wintergrasp Fortress in Wintergrasp.
Wintergrasp Fortress Walls are large walls that make up the defensive walls of Wintergrasp Fortress in Wintergrasp.
Wintergrasp Keep Towers are towers that house Wintergrasp Tower Cannons which are usable by players currently controlling Wintergrasp to defend Wintergrasp Fortress during battle.
Wintergrasp Tower Cannons are cannons players can use to defend the southern towers and Wintergrasp Fortress from attack in Wintergrasp.
Wintergarde Munitions Crates can be found in the area under Naxxramas in the Dragonblight.
Wintergrasp Victory is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning Wintergrasp.
Wintergrasp Veteran is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning Wintergrasp 100 times.
Wintergrasp Ranger is a player vs. player achievement earned for killing 10 players in each of the Wintergrasp areas.

Witch's Sanctum is an area inside Sunwell Plateau. The Eredar Twins are found here as well as several felblood elves. The zone is a circular room that begins with a 2-way ramp taking up half the room, just below the ramp is where the twins Alythess & Sacrolash stand, in a glowing runic circle on the ground. The sanctum is lit by golden crystals and a large blue light chandelier. Before 2.4.2, there were bluelight candles on the ramp. The ramp itself was often called the "Ledge Boss" due to a trivial difficulty of caster classes standing on the edge during the fight with the twins.
Wintergarde Miner's Cards drop from Risen Wintergarde Miners in the Wintergarde Mine in Dragonblight.
A witch's circlet is a simple string of bead-sized bones worn around the head that grants its wearer heightened awareness. Lady Vashj is apparently in possesion of one.
The Witchdoctor Leggings are a quest reward from Three Little Pygmies.

Winterax Hunters were members of the Winterax tribe located at the Snowfall Graveyard of Alterac Valley.

Wisp Amulet is an epic archaeology artifact that requires 450 skill to find and 150 Night Elf Archaeology Fragments to solve. Up to three Highborne Scroll keystones may be used to complete it.

Winterwater drops from Frostilicus and Ice Avatars in Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring.
A hempen robe wound around a core of braided wrought-iron wire, wirecore rope is more durable and can carry heavier loads than traditional rope.

Winterspring is a level 50-55 landlocked contested zone in northeastern Kalimdor. Players arrive from Felwood at the exit from Timbermaw Hold and progress east towards Everlook, then fork north and south until the story culminates with the defeat of Umbranse the Spiritspeaker. The progression of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Winterspring Quests.
Winzy Truesprocket is a gnome engineering supplies vendor located at Darkbreak Cove in the Alliance cavern in the Abyssal Depths.

__NOTOC__ Witch Doctor Umbu is a jungle troll shaman trainer found walking in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar. He was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
__NOTOC__ The Winterspring Cub is sold by at Everlook in Winterspring for .
Winterspring Cub Whiskers are a quest reward from A Cub's Cravings and Cub's First Toy (quest).
The Winterspring Cat Toy is created by combining Tough Yeti Hide with five Wildkin Feather.
Winterfall Belt is a quest reward from Threat of the Winterfall.
__NOTOC__ Witch Doctor T'wansi is a jungle troll witch doctor found at the entrance into Zul'Aman.
Witch-Hunter's Harvester is created with Blacksmithing (525); taught by Plans: Witch-Hunter's Harvester.
Winterfin Tadpoles are young murlocs captured by the corrupted murlocs of their village. They're found in cages within Winterfin Village of the Borean Tundra.

Wise Mari is the first boss in the Temple of the Jade Serpent. Shortly before the sha eruption, Wise Mari accepted the help of the adventurers who found his staff that was lost because of sprites. The waters of the Temple of the Jade Serpent have been tainted by the Sha of Doubts influence, and the jinyu waterspeaker Wise Mari was tainted right along with them. He was then killed by the same adventurers thus cleansing himself. Wise Mari appears as a ghost on the Timeless Isle participating in the Celestial Tournament with Carpe Diem, River and Spirus.
Wise Ana Wu is a pandaren lorewalker found on a raft at the center of Nayeli Lagoon in Krasarang Wilds.
Wishbone is a grummle located in the Grummle Bazaar in Kun-Lai Summit.
Winterbough Glade is a small clearing between Mistfall Village, Whitepetal Lake, and the Ruins of Guo-Lai in west-central Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Witchberry Seeds are purchased from for in the Halfhill Market. They can be planted at Sunsong Ranch to grow Witchberries. Seeds can also rarely be found while harvesting at the farm.

__NOTOC__ Witchberries are a cooking ingredient. They can be found on any saurok or sprite on Pandaria as well as grown at Sunsong Ranch from Witchberry Seeds. The witchberry is a juicy, dark red fruit that is initially very sour as it grows, but noted to become very sweet when ripe. This makes them a particularly popular treat with children.
The Winterfall Cauldron is found in the Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring. It is the source that spreads the corruption. It was imported from Felwood.
Wisdom of the Emperor is located in the Summer Fields in Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Interacting with it will replay the cutscene that appears after turning in Why Do We Fight? (quest).
Wise Mistweaver Spirits are pandaren spirits found in the small pandaren crates during the Spoils of Pandaria encounter.
Winterwasp Antidotes drop from Bladespire Geomancers at the Circle of Blood in Frostfire Ridge.
Yang Wei is a pandaren located near the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest. He wields Umbrella of Chi-Ji, wears the Lorewalkers Tabard, and is sitting on a green dragon turtle.
__NOTOC__ Witch Lord Morkurk is an ogre found at the Throne of the Witch Lord in Talador.
Wispy Tail Hair drops from stags and camels in Cataclysm zones.
Using this item invites Brew-Witch Shadowpaw to set up her cauldron of Mysterious Brew outside the Town Hall.
Winterfin "Depth Charge" can be purchased from Ahlurglgr at Winterfin Retreat in the Borean Tundra for 1 Winterfin Clam.
Winterfin Horns of Distress can be purchased from Ahlurglgr at Winterfin Retreat in Borean Tundra for 5 . The item summons a Winterfin First Responder who helps out in combat for 30 seconds.

The Winterskorn War was a conflict between titan-forged instigated by the fire giants Volkhan and Ignis after the titan-forged were exiled from Ulduar by Loken. They armed the Winterskorn clan of vrykul who attacked other titan-forged across the Storm Peaks, and caught the attention of Tyr when they attacked the earthen. Tyr asked the Dragon Aspects for aid, and the war ended with Ysera and Nozdormu putting the Winterskorn into a timeless sleep beneath northern Kalimdor. It was first mentioned as the first war between the earthen and the iron dwarves, where only a few facts were known, such as the participation of Urel Stoneheart, the first king of the earthen, and the destruction of Val'any
Wintron is an automatron built by Robert "Chance" Llore in order to eradicate Pesky Bugs in Dalaran.
Wisp in a Bottle is found in the Glimmering Treasure Chest at the end of the Withered Army Training scenario.

Winwa is a pandaren child located in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. She is in a balloon with Chao-Ju, Jising, Winsum, and Jiming.
Witch Doctor Hukari is a Zandalari troll located at Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor. He is seen speaking with Voodoo Priest Golomojo.
Witch Doctah Toko is a Zandalari troll kid standing with Witch Doctah Likola at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor. Upon speaking to him, the Speaker of the Horde is hexed.
Witch Doctor Unbugu is a jungle troll located in Dazar'alor. She is dancing to a Healing Ward.
Winterfin Gatherers are murlocs located at Winterfin Retreat in the Borean Tundra.
Winterfin Shorestrikers are murlocs located in the Westrift in the Borean Tundra.
Winterax Speakers are ice troll emissaries of the Winterax tribe located at the Terrace of the Speakers in Dazar'alor. One was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.
Witch of the Woods, real name Petula Algerson, is a witch located at Fernwood Ridge in Tiragarde Sound. Following her death, she was buried at Hatherford. Her daughter sometimes goes to visit her.
Witch Torches are torches located in the Crimson Forest in Drustvar. The three torches circle a Hexed Chest.
Warlords of Draenor Trailer: Wish You Were Here is an official trailer promoting the level 90 Character Boost. It's the first of 4 videos to feature the gnome character Lemmy.
Witch Doctor Jala is a Zandalari troll located in the Grand Bazaar in Zuldazar.
in Dazar'alor.]] Witch Doctor Jangalar is a Zandalari troll located in the Slough in Zuldazar. She later appeared in Dazar'alor alongside Little Ben'maka during Talanji's coronation.
Witch Doctah Likola is a Zandalari troll kid standing next to Witch Doctah Toko at the Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.

Witch Doctor Oinga is a Zandalari troll located in Dazar'alor. She is a herald of Bwonsamdi. She was killed by the forces opposing Talanji's ascension to the throne. Her body was dropped at Talanji's feet, a note pinned to her chest that read, "Bwonsamdi's puppet! The faithful will not kneel." Subsequently, her body was picked up by Zolani.
Wirt's Gambled Leg is an object lying on a chest at the entrance to the Dead Man's Tale inn in the uninstanced Freehold in Tiragarde Sound.
Wistel Silversnitch is a goblin located at Ar'gorok in the Arathi Highlands.
Witch Doctor's Slippers can be purchased from Ransa Greyfeather in Dazar'alor for after reaching with the Honorbound.

Witch Doctor Zentimo is a Zandalari troll located in Nazmir. He served the loa Krag'wa until they were attacked by the blood trolls. He was injured and eventually succumbed to his wounds after asking the Horde adventurer. His body was delivered to the loa who asked the adventurer to perform a ritual to honor the witch doctor. By using the Scepter of Rebirth, his spirit was sent to join the other deceased followers.
Winterax Mourners are ice trolls located in Dazar'alor during The King's Death.
Winterdeep Basin is an area located in southern Tiragarde Sound. It is the basin located near Winterdeep Mining Camp.
The Witch Doctor's Hoard is a chest located in Rootway in Zuldazar.
Wishing Frogs are frogs located at Owen's Wishing Well in the Jade Forest.
Wise Tu'aka is a Zandalari troll located in the Crypt of the First King in Kings' Rest.
Winterax Cave was a cave located behind Winterax Hold in Alterac Valley. Due to an avalanche, the cave along with most of the Winterax Hold was blocked off from the rest of the valley.

The Winterpaw clan is a furbolg clan found in the Grizzly Hills of Northrend. While less than half of the furbolg population is found in Grizzlemaw, the rest are gathered in clans and scattered throughout the Grizzly Hills. Each clan has its own totem, and when you see one you know you have entered their land. Because of this it is best to declare yourself openly once you see the totem, since a furbolg may be watching and will not appreciate your trying to sneak past.

__NOTOC__ Winterdeep Mining Camp is a mining camp located in southern Tiragarde Sound, deep within the Winterdeep Basin. The camp has been overrun by Azerite elementals and Azerite oozelings, and local miners are attempting to reclaim it.
